description: The whole Webflow Data API, plus a local database that lets you audit SEO, diff staging against live, and preview a publish before you trigger it.

novel_features.name: Page SEO audit
novel_features.description: Find every page on a site with a missing, duplicated, or over-length SEO title or description before it costs you traffic.

novel_features.name: Staged-vs-live drift
novel_features.description: See exactly which CMS items were edited in staging but never published, field by field.

novel_features.name: Publish preview
novel_features.description: See everything that would change if you published this site right now: pages edited since the last publish, draft pages, and unpublished CMS items, alongside the site's redirect-rule count.

novel_features.name: Query-driven bulk field set
novel_features.description: Apply the same field value to many CMS items selected by a condition. Previews the change set by default; --apply writes it, paced so you never hit a rate limit mid-run.

novel_features.name: Collection field completeness
novel_features.description: Per-field fill rate across a whole collection, so you can spot required fields nobody filled and schema fields nobody uses.

novel_features.name: Redirect table audit
novel_features.description: Catch redirects that shadow a live page, point nowhere, loop, or duplicate another rule.

novel_features.name: Multi-site rollup
novel_features.description: One row per site you have synced locally: pages, collections, unpublished items, SEO findings, days since last publish.
